title: 新河峽大橋~New River Gorge Bridge
focus: 以耐候鋼兩鉸桁架拱、峽谷纜索吊運與背拉懸臂架設，跨越 267 公尺深的峽谷~Spanning a gorge 267 m deep with a weathering-steel two-hinged truss arch erected by gorge cableway and tieback cantilevering
summary: 新河峽大橋位於美國西維吉尼亞州，主拱跨度 1,700 英尺（約 518 公尺），全長 3,030 英尺（約 924 公尺），橋面高出新河約 876 英尺（約 267 公尺），1977 年通車，以免塗裝的 COR-TEN 耐候鋼建造。本課從兩鉸桁架拱與峽谷地形出發，分析排架立柱、上承式桁架、焊接箱形弦桿與低溫韌性，再拆解跨越峽谷的纜索吊運、以油井套管作背拉索的懸臂架設與 1976 年以 16 具千斤頂完成的合龍，最後談線形量測、載重評等、耐候鋼維護與橋梁日活動的管理。~New River Gorge Bridge in West Virginia has a 1,700 ft (about 518 m) arch, a total length of 3,030 ft (about 924 m) and a deck about 876 ft (about 267 m) above the New River; it opened in 1977, built of unpainted COR-TEN weathering steel. Starting from the two-hinged truss arch and the gorge, the course examines spandrel bents, deck trusses, welded box chords and low-temperature toughness, then the cableway across the gorge, cantilever erection held by oil-well-casing tiebacks and the 1976 closure with 16 hydraulic jacks, ending with geometry surveys, load rating, care of weathering steel and managing Bridge Day.

units.anchor: 兩鉸桁架拱推力~Two-hinged truss-arch thrust
units.title: 峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱~The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch
units.mechanism: 新河峽谷兩側是陡峭的岩壁，深約 267 公尺，谷底無法設置中間橋墩，堅硬的岩壁卻正好能承受拱的推力，因此選擇上承式鋼拱。主拱是兩鉸桁架拱，只在兩端支點設鉸、拱頂不設鉸，拱矢 370 英尺，矢跨比約 1:4.6；拱肋桁架深度由拱頂約 34 英尺增加到支點處約 53 英尺。國家史蹟登錄文件指出，上下弦桿在錨碇處透過位於兩弦之間的銷共同承受壓力。橋面荷載經排架立柱傳到拱上，再以軸壓與推力送入兩岸的混凝土推力座。~The New River Gorge has steep rock walls about 267 m deep, so no intermediate piers could stand in the valley, yet the hard rock walls are ideal for resisting arch thrust, which led to a deck arch in steel. The main arch is a two-hinged truss arch, hinged only at its supports and not at the crown, with a rise of 370 ft and a rise-to-span ratio of about 1:4.6; rib depth grows from about 34 ft at the crown to about 53 ft at the supports. The National Register nomination notes that top and bottom chords share compression at the anchorage through a pin placed midway between them. Deck loads pass down spandrel bents to the arch and then, as axial force and thrust, into concrete thrust blocks on each side.
units.model: 拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。L = 1,700 ft ≈ 518.2 m、f = 370 ft ≈ 112.8 m，取總荷載 w = 250 kN/m：H = 250×518.2²/(8×112.8) ≈ 74,400 kN。若拱矢降為 L/6 ≈ 86.4 m，推力升到約 97,100 kN，增加約 31%。w 為教學假設。~Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f). With L = 1,700 ft ≈ 518.2 m, f = 370 ft ≈ 112.8 m and a total load w = 250 kN/m, H = 250×518.2²/(8×112.8) ≈ 74,400 kN. Reducing the rise to L/6 ≈ 86.4 m raises the thrust to about 97,100 kN, about 31% more. w is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑；營運期以測量監測推力座與拱腳的位移，因為兩鉸拱的內力對支點水平位移很敏感。~At design stage analyse chord and web forces under full-span, half-span and concentrated loads with a truss model and check the thrust blocks for rock bearing and sliding; in service monitor thrust-block and arch-foot movements by survey, since a two-hinged arch's forces are sensitive to horizontal support movement.
units.failure: 推力座若因岩體節理或風化而滑動，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，弦桿彎曲應力大增；排水不良使推力座背後積水，水壓與凍脹可能推動岩塊，形成長期的漸進位移。~If a thrust block slides on jointed or weathered rock, the span lengthens, the crown drops and chord bending rises sharply; poor drainage behind a block lets water pressure and frost heave push rock blocks, causing slow progressive movement.
units.misconception: 峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。~A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust.
units.practice: 拱橋選址時應先完成岩盤調查與推力座的穩定分析，並把推力座背後的排水列為長期維護項目；監測計畫須包含拱腳的三維位移量測與異常門檻。~Siting an arch requires rock investigation and thrust-block stability analysis first, with drainage behind the blocks treated as a long-term maintenance item; the monitoring plan must include 3D movement of the arch feet with alert thresholds.

units.title: 排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承~Bents, deck trusses and bearings
units.mechanism: 橋面由 23 跨的 Warren 式上承桁架組成，桁架深 18 英尺；拱上 14 跨每跨約 129 英尺 9 英寸，南側引橋 5 跨、北側引橋 4 跨。桁架支承在排架上，拱上的排架立柱高度由約 25 英尺到 304 英尺不等，間距 72 英尺，立柱為中空斷面並以斜撐連接。登錄文件記載支承配置：靠近拱頂的幾座排架用搖軸支承，其餘排架用固定支承，拱兩端的排架則使用齒輪式伸縮支承。這種配置讓橋面與拱之間的相對溫度變形有處可釋放，又讓水平力有明確的傳遞路徑。~The deck consists of 23 spans of Warren deck trusses 18 ft deep: 14 spans of about 129 ft 9 in over the arch, five on the south approach and four on the north. The trusses sit on bents; spandrel bent columns over the arch range from about 25 ft to 304 ft tall at 72 ft spacing, with hollow sections linked by diagonal bracing. The nomination records the bearing layout: rocker shoes on the bents nearest the crown, fixed shoes elsewhere and gear-type expansion bearings on the bents at the arch ends. This arrangement releases relative thermal movement between deck and arch while giving horizontal forces a clear path.
units.model: 高 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m 的立柱若視為兩端鉸接、無中間支撐，歐拉挫屈荷載 P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)²。取 E = 200 GPa、I = 0.05 m⁴、K = 1.0：P_cr = π²×200×10⁶×0.05/92.7² ≈ 11,500 kN；若斜撐使有效長度減半，P_cr 提高 4 倍到約 46,000 kN。I 與 K 為教學假設。~Treating a 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m column as pin-ended without intermediate bracing, the Euler load is P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)². With E = 200 GPa, I = 0.05 m⁴ and K = 1.0, P_cr = π²×200×10⁶×0.05/92.7² ≈ 11,500 kN; bracing that halves the effective length raises P_cr fourfold to about 46,000 kN. I and K are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以整體模型檢查高立柱在軸力、風力與溫度變形下的二階效應，並確認斜撐節點的勁度足以提供假設的側向支撐；現場檢查搖軸支承的傾角與齒輪式支承的齒合位置，與溫度對照判斷是否正常。~Check second-order effects in the tall columns under axial load, wind and thermal deformation with a global model, confirming bracing joints are stiff enough to provide the assumed lateral restraint; in the field inspect rocker tilt and gear-bearing tooth engagement against temperature to judge whether they behave normally.
units.failure: 斜撐連接若因腐蝕或鬆動失效，立柱有效長度增加，挫屈強度大幅下降；搖軸支承卡死或傾角超出設計範圍時，溫度力被迫由立柱承受，可能造成立柱彎曲或支承損壞。~If bracing connections fail by corrosion or loosening, column effective length grows and buckling strength drops sharply; seized rockers or tilts beyond the design range force thermal loads into the columns, bending them or damaging bearings.
units.misconception: 立柱只承受垂直壓力，斜撐只是為了外觀或施工方便。~Columns only take vertical compression, and the bracing is just for appearance or construction convenience.
units.practice: 檢查手冊應把高立柱的斜撐節點與各類支承列為重點項目，記錄每次檢查時的溫度與支承位置；任何斜撐構件的更換須先提供臨時支撐並經結構工程師核准。~The inspection manual should prioritise bracing joints of tall columns and every bearing type, recording temperature and bearing positions at each inspection; replacing any bracing member requires temporary support and structural-engineer approval first.

units.anchor: COR-TEN B 耐候鋼~COR-TEN B weathering steel
units.title: 耐候鋼與低溫韌性~Weathering steel and low-temperature toughness
units.mechanism: 新河峽大橋以 COR-TEN B 耐候鋼建造，鋼中的銅、鉻、鎳等合金元素讓表面在乾濕交替下形成緻密的鏽層，減緩後續腐蝕，因此不需塗裝，國家公園管理局也說明大橋的鏽色外觀不需重新油漆。設計者必須確保焊道的風化速率與母材相近，以免焊縫處顏色或腐蝕行為不同。另一個關鍵是低溫韌性：西維吉尼亞冬季寒冷，鋼材在低溫下若韌性不足，小裂紋可能在未達降伏強度時就突然脆斷，因此主要受拉構件需要規定衝擊韌性。~The bridge is built of COR-TEN B weathering steel, whose copper, chromium and nickel let a dense rust layer form under wetting and drying and slow further corrosion, so no paint is needed; the National Park Service notes that the rust-coloured finish never needs repainting. Designers had to make welds weather at the same rate as the base steel so joints would not differ in colour or corrosion behaviour. Low-temperature toughness is the other key: West Virginia winters are cold, and steel with poor toughness can fracture suddenly from small cracks below yield stress, so main tension members need specified impact toughness.
units.model: 臨界裂紋深度 a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]²。取 Y = 1.12、σ = 150 MPa：常溫 K_c = 100 MPa·√m 時 a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm；低溫 K_c 降到 50 MPa·√m 時 a_c ≈ 28 mm，只剩四分之一。K_c 與應力為教學假設。~Critical crack depth a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]². With Y = 1.12 and σ = 150 MPa, K_c = 100 MPa·√m at mild temperature gives a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm; if K_c falls to 50 MPa·√m in the cold, a_c ≈ 28 mm, only a quarter. K_c and stress are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 鋼材採購規定 Charpy 衝擊試驗溫度與最低能量，依構件是否為斷裂關鍵構件分級；焊接程序評定包含焊道與熱影響區的韌性，並以試片驗證焊材的耐候性能與母材相符。~Purchase specifications set Charpy test temperature and minimum energy, graded by whether members are fracture-critical; welding procedure qualification includes weld and heat-affected-zone toughness, and coupons verify that filler metal weathers like the base steel.
units.failure: 若受拉構件使用低溫韌性不足的鋼材或焊材，冬季重車通過時，焊趾的小缺陷可能在無明顯預兆下脆斷；焊材耐候性不符時，焊道優先腐蝕形成凹槽，成為疲勞與斷裂的起點。~Steel or filler with poor low-temperature toughness in tension members can fracture without warning from small weld-toe flaws under winter truck loads; mismatched filler metal corrodes preferentially into grooves that start fatigue cracks and fractures.
units.misconception: 耐候鋼會自己形成保護鏽層，所以任何環境、任何細節都不需要考慮腐蝕與韌性。~Weathering steel forms its own protective rust, so corrosion and toughness need no attention in any environment or detail.
units.practice: 材料規範應同時列出耐候化學成分、Charpy 韌性等級與焊材匹配要求，斷裂關鍵構件另有加嚴的檢驗；竣工資料保存鋼材爐號與試驗報告，供日後評估使用。~The material specification should cover weathering chemistry, Charpy toughness class and filler matching together, with stricter inspection for fracture-critical members; as-built records keep heat numbers and test reports for future assessment.

units.anchor: 焊接箱形弦桿~Welded box chords
units.title: 焊接箱形弦桿與桁架節點~Welded box chords and truss joints
units.mechanism: 拱肋的上下弦桿是單室焊接箱形斷面：兩片 58 英寸高、2 至 4 英寸厚的腹板，配上兩片 39 英寸寬、約 13/16 至 1½ 英寸厚的蓋板。箱形斷面在兩個方向都有良好的抗挫屈能力，適合承受拱的巨大軸壓；上下弦之間以 Howe 式桁架腹桿連接，兩片拱肋之間以 K 形斜撐連成整體以抵抗橫向風力。焊接箱形構件的關鍵在於厚板焊接品質、殘餘應力與節點處的應力集中，這些都會影響挫屈強度與疲勞。~The arch chords are single-cell welded boxes: two webs 58 in deep and 2 to 4 in thick with two cover plates 39 in wide and about 13/16 to 1½ in thick. A box section resists buckling well in both directions and suits the arch's large axial compression; Howe-truss web members join the chords, and K-bracing ties the two ribs together against lateral wind. For welded box members the critical issues are thick-plate weld quality, residual stresses and stress concentrations at joints, all of which affect buckling strength and fatigue.
units.model: 取腹板 58 in ≈ 1,473 mm × 3 in ≈ 76 mm 兩片、蓋板 39 in ≈ 991 mm × 1¼ in ≈ 31.75 mm 兩片：A ≈ 2×1,473×76 + 2×991×31.75 ≈ 286,800 mm² ≈ 0.287 m²。以降伏強度 345 MPa 計，全斷面降伏軸力約 0.287×345 ≈ 99 MN；未計挫屈折減。板厚選擇為教學假設。~Taking two webs of 58 in ≈ 1,473 mm × 3 in ≈ 76 mm and two cover plates of 39 in ≈ 991 mm × 1¼ in ≈ 31.75 mm, A ≈ 2×1,473×76 + 2×991×31.75 ≈ 286,800 mm² ≈ 0.287 m². At a yield strength of 345 MPa the squash load is about 0.287×345 ≈ 99 MN, before any buckling reduction. Plate choices are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 厚板全滲透焊道以超音波檢測，角焊縫以磁粒檢測抽驗；製造後量測箱形構件的直線度、扭曲與斷面尺寸，與挫屈設計假設的初始缺陷比較；節點組裝後檢查螺栓或焊接的配合與間隙。~Test thick-plate full-penetration welds ultrasonically and sample fillet welds by magnetic particle; after fabrication measure straightness, twist and section dimensions of box members against the initial imperfections assumed in buckling design; after joint assembly check fit-up and gaps of bolts or welds.
units.failure: 厚板焊接若預熱不足，可能產生層狀撕裂或氫致裂紋；箱形構件內部若積水且無排水孔，耐候鋼在長期潮濕下無法形成保護鏽層，內部腐蝕持續而不易察覺。~Insufficient preheat on thick plates can cause lamellar tearing or hydrogen cracking; water trapped inside a box member without drain holes keeps weathering steel permanently wet so no protective patina forms, and hidden internal corrosion continues.
units.misconception: 箱形斷面是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕，也不需要檢查。~A box section is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection.
units.practice: 箱形構件應設計排水孔與檢查開口，並在檢查計畫中安排定期內部檢查；厚板焊接需有預熱、層間溫度與焊後檢測的書面程序，由焊接檢驗員逐項簽認。~Box members need drain holes and access openings, with periodic interior inspection in the plan; thick-plate welding requires written procedures for preheat, interpass temperature and post-weld testing, signed off item by item by the welding inspector.

units.title: 跨越峽谷的纜索吊運~The cableway across the gorge
units.mechanism: 峽谷深而陡，無法從谷底以吊車把鋼構件吊上去，承包商於是在兩岸各設兩座約 330 英尺高的塔架，架設四條直徑 3 英寸的主纜，跨距約 3,500 英尺，以台車沿主纜把鋼構件運送到安裝位置。登錄文件記載每台台車能力 50 噸、兩台合計 100 噸，最重的一次吊運約 92 噸。纜索吊運的承載能力取決於主纜的垂度與張力：垂度越小，同樣荷載下主纜張力越大；台車移到跨中時主纜張力最大，塔架與錨碇也承受最大的水平力。~The gorge was too deep and steep to lift steel from the valley floor, so the contractor built two towers about 330 ft tall on each rim and strung four 3 in main cables across about 3,500 ft, running trolleys along them to carry steel to its erection position. The nomination records 50-ton trolleys, 100 tons combined, with a heaviest lift of about 92 tons. A cableway's capacity depends on cable sag and tension: the smaller the sag, the higher the tension for a given load; tension peaks when the trolley reaches mid-span, which also puts the largest horizontal force on towers and anchorages.
units.model: 跨距 L = 3,500 ft ≈ 1,067 m、垂度 f = 5%·L ≈ 53.3 m。跨中集中荷載 P = 92 t ≈ 902 kN 的水平張力 H_P = P·L/(4f) ≈ 902×1,067/(4×53.3) ≈ 4,510 kN；主纜自重 0.17 kN/m 的 H_w = w·L²/(8f) ≈ 450 kN。四條主纜分擔，每條約 1,240 kN；若每條破斷力 4,500 kN，安全係數約 3.6。垂度、自重與破斷力為教學假設。~Span L = 3,500 ft ≈ 1,067 m with sag f = 5%·L ≈ 53.3 m. A mid-span load P = 92 t ≈ 902 kN gives H_P = P·L/(4f) ≈ 902×1,067/(4×53.3) ≈ 4,510 kN, and cable self-weight of 0.17 kN/m adds H_w = w·L²/(8f) ≈ 450 kN. Shared by four cables, each carries about 1,240 kN; with a breaking strength of 4,500 kN per cable the factor of safety is about 3.6. Sag, self-weight and breaking strength are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 纜索系統啟用前以分級荷重試驗驗證主纜、台車、塔架與錨碇，量測各級荷重下的垂度與錨碇位移；每日作業前檢查鋼索斷絲、潤滑與端部固定，風速超過門檻即停止運送。~Before use, proof-load the cables, trolleys, towers and anchorages in stages while measuring sag and anchorage movement at each step; before each day's work inspect ropes for broken wires, lubrication and terminations, and stop transport when wind exceeds the limit.
units.failure: 公開資料記載施工期間曾發生纜索塔架倒塌，造成一名工人死亡、多人受傷，說明臨時吊運系統本身就是高風險結構；主纜張力或塔架穩定若只以靜力設計而忽略台車移動與擺盪的動態效應，可能在運送中失效。~Public records note that cableway towers collapsed during construction, killing one worker and injuring others, showing that temporary hoisting systems are high-risk structures in their own right; designing cable tension or tower stability statically while ignoring trolley motion and sway dynamics can lead to failure during transport.
units.misconception: 臨時纜索吊運系統只是施工機具，不需要像永久結構一樣設計與驗證。~A temporary cableway is just construction equipment and needs no design or verification like a permanent structure.
units.practice: 臨時吊運系統應由合格工程師設計並經獨立審查，作業程序明訂荷重上限、風速門檻、每日檢查表與停止條件；任何改變台車荷重或塔架配置的變更須重新核准，系統啟用前的荷重試驗為停留點。~Temporary hoisting systems must be designed by qualified engineers and independently checked, with procedures stating load limits, wind limits, daily checklists and stop criteria; any change to trolley loads or tower layout needs re-approval, and the pre-service load test is a hold point.

units.anchor: 背拉索與合龍千斤頂~Tiebacks and closure jacks
units.title: 背拉懸臂架設與 1976 年合龍~Tieback cantilevering and the 1976 closure
units.mechanism: 兩側半拱以懸臂方式從推力座向峽谷中央伸出，以背拉索取代谷底支架：登錄文件記載背拉索是以鋼管套管包覆的鋼絞線組，使用 9⅝ 英寸油井套管與 2⅜ 英寸鋼絞線，錨碇在推力座後方約 200 英尺的地錨基礎中。第一段弦桿於 1975 年夏季安裝，最後一件拱構件於 1976 年 5 月就位，接著以背拉系統與 16 具 1,250 噸液壓千斤頂把兩側拱臂下放、在拱頂接合；1976 年 11 月 1 日最後一段橋面桁架完成。背拉索的長度與拉力決定半拱端點的高程，合龍前必須精確調整。~Each half-arch was cantilevered from its thrust block toward mid-gorge, with tiebacks replacing valley falsework: the nomination records tieback assemblies of strands in steel pipe casing, using 9⅝ in oil-well casing and 2⅜ in strands, anchored in deadman foundations about 200 ft behind the abutments. The first chord was placed in summer 1975, the last arch piece was set in May 1976, and the tieback system with sixteen 1,250-ton hydraulic jacks then lowered both arms to meet at the crown; the final deck truss was set on 1 November 1976. Tieback length and force govern the level of each half-arch tip and had to be adjusted precisely before closure.
units.model: 16 具千斤頂各 1,250 噸（美制短噸），合計 20,000 短噸 ≈ 20,000×0.907 ≈ 18,100 公噸，約 178 MN。若每側 8 具、約 89 MN，要控制的背拉力約 72 MN 時利用率約 81%。背拉力為教學假設。~Sixteen jacks of 1,250 tons (US short tons) total 20,000 short tons ≈ 20,000×0.907 ≈ 18,100 t, about 178 MN. With 8 jacks per side, about 89 MN, controlling a tieback force of about 72 MN uses about 81% of capacity. The tieback force is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 每階段安裝後量測半拱端點的三維位置與背拉索力，與施工階段分析比較；下放合龍時同步記錄每具千斤頂的油壓與行程、拱臂端點的間隙與高差，並在溫度穩定時段完成最終對位。~After each erection stage survey the 3D position of each half-arch tip and the tieback forces against the staged analysis; during lowering and closure record the pressure and stroke of every jack together with the gap and level difference between tips, completing final alignment in a thermally stable window.
units.failure: 若千斤頂不同步，同一側的背拉索受力不均，拱臂扭轉或偏位，合龍處無法對準；地錨基礎若在拉力下位移，半拱端點下沉超出預期，甚至可能使懸臂失穩。~Unsynchronised jacks load tiebacks on one side unequally, twisting or offsetting the arm so the closure cannot align; a deadman that moves under load lets the tip drop more than expected and can destabilise the cantilever.
units.misconception: 合龍只是把最後一根構件吊上去接起來，千斤頂只是輔助。~Closure is just lifting the last member into place, with jacks as a minor aid.
units.practice: 背拉與合龍程序應明訂每步的背拉力與端點高程目標、千斤頂同步方式、停止條件與溫度條件；地錨基礎在使用前做驗證拉拔試驗，所有步驟的量測紀錄由設計代表簽認並歸檔。~The tieback and closure procedure should set tieback force and tip-level targets for each step, the jack synchronisation method, stop criteria and temperature conditions; deadmen are proof-tested before use, and every step's measurements are signed by the designer's representative and archived.

units.anchor: 拱頂高程溫度修正~Crown level temperature correction
units.title: 線形量測與溫度修正~Geometry surveys and temperature correction
units.mechanism: 鋼拱的線形隨溫度變化：均勻升溫使拱軸伸長，跨度被支點固定時拱頂只能上升；日照使朝陽面與背陽面溫度不同，又造成側向彎曲。施工中每一次量測都必須記錄鋼溫，換算到參考溫度後才能與設計線形比較，否則溫度造成的位移會被誤判為安裝誤差，導致錯誤的調整。完工後，拱頂高程與溫度的關係也成為監測基準：若相同溫度下高程逐年改變，可能代表支點位移或構件損傷。~A steel arch's geometry changes with temperature: uniform warming lengthens the arch axis, and with the span fixed by the supports the crown can only rise; sunshine heats one face more than the other and bends the arch sideways. Every survey during erection must record steel temperature and be corrected to a reference temperature before comparison with the design profile, or thermal movement will be mistaken for erection error and lead to wrong adjustments. After completion, the relation between crown level and temperature becomes a monitoring baseline: a level that changes year by year at the same temperature may indicate support movement or member damage.
units.model: 拋物線拱弧長 s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 518.2 + 8×112.8²/(3×518.2) ≈ 583.6 m。升溫 20 °C 時 Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×583.6×20 ≈ 0.140 m；跨度固定時拱矢增加 Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×518.2×0.140/(16×112.8) ≈ 0.121 m。也就是每度約 6 mm。溫差為教學假設。~The parabolic arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 518.2 + 8×112.8²/(3×518.2) ≈ 583.6 m. A 20 °C rise gives Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×583.6×20 ≈ 0.140 m, and with the span fixed the rise grows by Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×518.2×0.140/(16×112.8) ≈ 0.121 m, about 6 mm per degree. The temperature change is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 量測選在日出前溫度均勻時進行，並在弦桿上以接觸式溫度計或埋設感測器量測鋼溫；同一點在不同溫度下多次量測，回歸出高程—溫度斜率並與理論比較；量測成果換算到參考溫度後再與設計線形比對。~Survey before sunrise when temperatures are uniform, measuring steel temperature on the chords with contact thermometers or embedded sensors; measure the same points at several temperatures, regress the level–temperature slope against theory, and compare with the design profile only after correcting to the reference temperature.
units.failure: 若在午後日照下量測並據以調整背拉索，等到夜間降溫後拱頂下降超出允差，合龍時兩端高差過大；完工後的監測若不做溫度修正，季節變化會掩蓋真正的異常趨勢。~Surveying in afternoon sun and adjusting tiebacks on that basis leaves the crown too low once it cools at night, with a large level difference at closure; post-completion monitoring without temperature correction lets seasonal swings hide genuine abnormal trends.
units.misconception: 鋼構件很剛硬，溫度對拱的高程影響只有幾公釐，可以忽略。~Steel is stiff, so temperature changes the arch level by only a few millimetres and can be ignored.
units.practice: 測量規範應規定量測時段、鋼溫量測方法、參考溫度與修正公式，所有線形紀錄都要附溫度；完工時建立拱頂高程—溫度基準曲線，納入交接文件供長期監測使用。~The survey specification should fix measurement times, steel-temperature methods, the reference temperature and correction formula, attaching temperatures to every geometry record; at completion establish a crown level–temperature baseline curve and include it in the handover for long-term monitoring.

units.title: 檢查通道與載重評等~Inspection access and load rating
units.mechanism: 橋面下方沿全長設有約兩英尺寬的鋼製步道，原本就是為了檢查而建。對一座橋面高出河面 267 公尺的鋼拱橋而言，檢查通道決定了哪些構件能被近距離檢視：步道可以到達橋面桁架與部分排架，拱肋、高立柱與推力座則可能需要繩索技術或無人機。美國的公路橋梁須依國家橋梁檢查標準定期檢查，檢查結果與材料、斷面損失資料用於載重評等，決定橋梁能否承載法定車輛，或需要限重與補強。~A steel catwalk about two feet wide runs the full length under the deck, built originally for inspection. On a steel arch whose deck is 267 m above the river, access decides which members can be examined at arm's length: the catwalk reaches deck trusses and parts of the bents, while the arch ribs, tall columns and thrust blocks may need rope access or drones. US highway bridges must be inspected periodically under the National Bridge Inspection Standards, and the findings, with material and section-loss data, feed a load rating that decides whether the bridge can carry legal vehicles or needs posting or strengthening.
units.model: 載重評等因數 RF = (C − γ_DC·DC)/(γ_LL·(LL+IM))。某拱肋構件 C = 60 MN、恆載效應 DC = 38 MN、活載含衝擊 LL+IM = 6 MN，γ_DC = 1.25、γ_LL = 1.75：RF = (60 − 47.5)/10.5 ≈ 1.19 > 1.0；若腐蝕使容量降 5% 到 57 MN，RF ≈ 0.90，需要進一步評估。數值為教學假設。~Load rating factor RF = (C − γ_DC·DC)/(γ_LL·(LL+IM)). For an arch member with C = 60 MN, dead-load effect DC = 38 MN and live load with impact LL+IM = 6 MN, using γ_DC = 1.25 and γ_LL = 1.75, RF = (60 − 47.5)/10.5 ≈ 1.19 > 1.0; if corrosion cuts capacity 5% to 57 MN, RF ≈ 0.90 and further evaluation is needed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 檢查以目視、敲擊與超音波測厚記錄斷面損失、裂紋與鬆動螺栓，斷裂關鍵構件依規定做近距離檢查；載重評等以實測斷面與材料資料更新模型，結果與前次評等比較，評等低於門檻時啟動限重或補強決策。~Inspections record section loss, cracks and loose bolts by visual, tapping and ultrasonic thickness methods, with hands-on examination of fracture-critical members as required; the load rating updates the model with measured sections and material data, compares with the previous rating, and triggers posting or strengthening decisions when it falls below thresholds.
units.failure: 若檢查通道無法到達某些構件而長期只做遠距目視，斷面損失或裂紋可能在評等中被忽略，評等因數高估；高處檢查作業若缺乏墜落防護與救援計畫，檢查人員本身面臨重大風險。~If access cannot reach some members and they only get distant visual checks for years, section loss or cracks may be missed and the rating overestimated; high-level inspection without fall protection and rescue planning puts inspectors at serious risk.
units.misconception: 只要定期做目視檢查，就足以確定大型鋼拱橋的承載能力。~Periodic visual inspection alone is enough to establish the capacity of a large steel arch.
units.practice: 檢查計畫應列出每類構件的檢查方法與可達性（步道、繩索、無人機），並把無法近距離檢查的構件標示為風險項目；載重評等報告須由專業工程師簽認，評等因數低於 1.0 的構件立即通報業主。~The inspection plan should list method and access (catwalk, rope, drone) for each member type and flag members that cannot be reached closely as risk items; load-rating reports must be sealed by a professional engineer, and members rating below 1.0 reported to the owner immediately.

units.anchor: 伸縮縫漏水與耐候鋼~Joint leakage on weathering steel
units.title: 耐候鋼的長期維護~Long-term care of weathering steel
units.mechanism: 耐候鋼的保護鏽層只有在乾濕交替、表面能乾燥的條件下才會形成。橋面伸縮縫漏水、排水管斷裂或除冰鹽水長期滴落在同一位置，會讓鋼材持續潮濕並含氯離子，鏽層變得鬆散剝落，腐蝕速率大幅增加；鳥糞與碎屑堆積在節點板與下弦桿上也有類似效果。因此耐候鋼橋的維護重點不是油漆，而是讓水離開鋼材：修好伸縮縫與排水、清除堆積物，並在局部劣化處考慮塗裝。~The protective patina of weathering steel forms only where the surface can wet and then dry. Leaking deck joints, broken drains or de-icing brine dripping on one spot keep the steel wet and chloride-laden, so the rust layer turns loose and flaky and corrosion speeds up greatly; bird droppings and debris collecting on gusset plates and bottom chords have a similar effect. Maintenance of a weathering-steel bridge is therefore not about paint but about getting water off the steel: repairing joints and drainage, removing deposits and considering local coating where deterioration has started.
units.model: 大氣腐蝕常以冪次律 C = A·tⁿ 估計。取第一年損失 A = 10 μm：正常乾濕條件 n = 0.5，50 年損失 10×50^0.5 ≈ 71 μm；長期潮濕含鹽 n = 0.8，50 年損失 10×50^0.8 ≈ 229 μm，約為 3.2 倍。A 與 n 為教學假設。~Atmospheric corrosion is often estimated by the power law C = A·tⁿ. With a first-year loss A = 10 μm, normal wet–dry exposure with n = 0.5 gives 10×50^0.5 ≈ 71 μm after 50 years; persistently wet, salty exposure with n = 0.8 gives 10×50^0.8 ≈ 229 μm, about 3.2 times as much. A and n are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 檢查時記錄鏽層的顏色、質地與附著性（緻密或片狀剝落），並在可疑處以超音波測厚量測剩餘厚度；以伸縮縫與排水口的位置為檢查重點，比較各區的腐蝕程度，追蹤歷年趨勢。~Record patina colour, texture and adherence (tight or flaking) during inspection, measuring remaining thickness ultrasonically at suspect spots; focus on locations below joints and drains, comparing corrosion between zones and tracking trends over the years.
units.failure: 伸縮縫長年漏水使下方支承與排架頂部腐蝕成片狀剝落，斷面損失持續累積，最後需要大規模切除更換；若以為耐候鋼完全免維護而延誤排水修繕，局部腐蝕可能演變成結構性損傷。~Years of joint leakage flake away the steel at bearings and bent tops below, accumulating section loss until large replacements are needed; treating weathering steel as maintenance-free and delaying drainage repairs can turn local corrosion into structural damage.
units.misconception: 耐候鋼橋完全免維護，不需要任何防蝕管理。~Weathering-steel bridges are completely maintenance-free and need no corrosion management.
units.practice: 維護計畫應把伸縮縫、排水與碎屑清除列為定期工作，檢查表中加入鏽層狀態分類；對長期潮濕或含鹽的局部區域，由工程師決定是否改善排水或局部塗裝，並記錄處置位置。~The maintenance plan should schedule joint, drainage and debris work regularly and add patina condition classes to the checklist; where zones stay wet or salty, an engineer decides on drainage improvements or local coating, and the locations treated are recorded.

units.anchor: 橋梁日人群荷載~Bridge Day crowd load
units.title: 橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接~Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover
units.mechanism: 大橋由西維吉尼亞州交通部門管理，位於新河峽國家公園範圍內；每年十月第三個星期六的橋梁日會封閉車道，開放行人上橋並舉辦跳傘活動，自 1980 年起舉辦。2013 年大橋列入美國國家史蹟名錄，代表它的工程價值被正式認定，日後修繕需兼顧保存。對結構而言，大量人群集中在橋面是一種特殊荷載情境：人群密度可能高於一般設計的行人荷載假設，而且分布不均，必須事先評估並以活動管理控制。~The bridge is managed by West Virginia's transportation department and lies within New River Gorge National Park; on Bridge Day, the third Saturday of October since 1980, traffic lanes close and pedestrians and parachutists take over the deck. In 2013 the bridge was listed on the National Register of Historic Places, formally recognising its engineering value so future repairs must respect conservation. Structurally, a large crowd on the deck is a special load case: crowd density can exceed ordinary pedestrian design assumptions and be unevenly distributed, so it must be assessed in advance and controlled by event management.
units.model: 以 AASHTO 行人荷載 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa 作為密集人群強度，乘以橋面寬約 21.1 m，線荷載 ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m；四車道設計車道荷載各約 9.3 kN/m，合計約 37.2 kN/m，人群線荷載約為其兩倍（尚未計設計卡車與多車道折減）。比較方式為教學假設。~Using the AASHTO pedestrian load of 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa as a dense-crowd intensity over a deck about 21.1 m wide gives ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m; four design lane loads of about 9.3 kN/m each total about 37.2 kN/m, so the crowd line load is roughly double, before design trucks and multiple-presence factors. The comparison is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 活動前以結構模型比較人群荷載與設計荷載的效應，決定可容許的人數、分區與動線；活動期間以入口計數與分區管控維持密度，必要時在代表性構件裝設臨時應變或位移量測；活動後檢查欄杆、伸縮縫與步道。~Before the event compare crowd and design load effects in the structural model to set allowable numbers, zones and routes; during the event keep density in check with gate counts and zone control, adding temporary strain or displacement monitoring on representative members if needed; inspect railings, joints and walkways afterwards.
units.failure: 若人群集中在少數觀景點，局部欄杆與橋面板承受遠高於平均的荷載；活動附屬設施（舞台、跳傘設備、臨時固定）若未經結構檢核就固定在橋上，可能損傷構件或耐候鋼表面。~Crowds concentrated at a few viewpoints load local railings and deck panels far above the average; event fixtures such as stages, parachuting equipment or temporary anchors attached without structural review can damage members or the weathering-steel surface.
units.misconception: 行人比車輛輕得多，所以人群上橋對結構沒有影響。~Pedestrians weigh far less than vehicles, so crowds on a bridge have no structural effect.
units.practice: 大型活動應有書面結構評估、人數上限、分區與緊急疏散計畫，並由橋梁管理機關核准；交接文件包含檢查紀錄、載重評等、史蹟登錄的保存要求、活動評估與歷年維修資料，由州交通部門與國家公園管理單位共享。~Large events need a written structural assessment, crowd caps, zoning and an emergency evacuation plan approved by the bridge owner; handover files include inspections, load ratings, historic-listing conservation requirements, event assessments and repair history, shared between the state transportation department and the park service.

example: 合龍千斤頂練習：假設合龍前每個半拱重 W = 4,000 t（約 39.2 MN），重心距拱腳鉸 110 m，背拉索對鉸的力臂 60 m，所需背拉力 T = W·x/h = 39.2×110/60 ≈ 71.9 MN。每側 8 具 1,250 短噸千斤頂，能力約 8×1,250×0.907×9.81 ≈ 89 MN，利用率約 81%。下放時放出背拉索 Δc = 0.15 m，半拱轉角 θ = 0.15/60 = 2.5 mrad；拱頂端點距鉸高約 112.8 m、水平約 259 m，端點向中央移動約 2.5×10⁻³×112.8 ≈ 0.28 m，下降約 2.5×10⁻³×259 ≈ 0.65 m。半拱弧長約 292 m，溫度變化 10 °C 使長度變化約 292×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm，所以最後幾公分的對位必須在溫度穩定時完成。數值為教學假設，不代表新河峽大橋的實際設計或施工數據。~Closure-jack exercise: assume each half-arch weighs W = 4,000 t (about 39.2 MN) before closure, with its centroid 110 m from the arch-foot hinge and a 60 m tieback lever arm about the hinge, so the required tieback force is T = W·x/h = 39.2×110/60 ≈ 71.9 MN. Eight 1,250 short-ton jacks per side give about 8×1,250×0.907×9.81 ≈ 89 MN, a utilisation of about 81%. Paying out Δc = 0.15 m of tieback rotates the half-arch by θ = 0.15/60 = 2.5 mrad; with the tip about 112.8 m above and about 259 m horizontally from the hinge, it moves about 2.5×10⁻³×112.8 ≈ 0.28 m toward mid-span and drops about 2.5×10⁻³×259 ≈ 0.65 m. A half-arch about 292 m long changes length by about 292×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm for 10 °C, so the last few centimetres of alignment must be made when temperature is stable. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual design or erection data of the bridge.
history: 為了讓阿帕拉契山區的公路不必繞行深谷，西維吉尼亞州公路部門委託 Michael Baker 公司設計跨越新河峽谷的大橋，由總工程師 Clarence V. Knudsen 主持；美國鋼鐵公司旗下的 American Bridge 部門承攬施工，1974 年 6 月開工。承包商以跨越峽谷的纜索吊運系統運送鋼構件，以油井套管背拉索懸臂架設兩側半拱，1976 年 5 月以液壓千斤頂下放合龍，1977 年 10 月 22 日通車，造價逾 3,700 萬美元。完工時它是世界最長的單跨鋼拱，並長期保持西半球最長鋼拱跨度的紀錄，2013 年列入國家史蹟名錄。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。~To spare Appalachian highway traffic a long detour around the gorge, West Virginia's highway department commissioned Michael Baker to design a crossing of the New River Gorge, led by chief engineer Clarence V. Knudsen; the American Bridge Division of U.S. Steel built it, starting in June 1974. The contractor carried steel by a cableway across the gorge, cantilevered both half-arches on oil-well-casing tiebacks, lowered them together with hydraulic jacks in May 1976 and opened the bridge on 22 October 1977 at a cost of more than US$37 million. On completion it was the world's longest single-span steel arch, and it long remained the longest steel arch span in the Western Hemisphere; it joined the National Register of Historic Places in 2013. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.
facts: 主拱跨度 1,700 英尺（約 518 公尺），全長 3,030 英尺（約 924 公尺）~The arch spans 1,700 ft (about 518 m) and the bridge is 3,030 ft (about 924 m) long
橋面高出新河約 876 英尺（約 267 公尺）~The deck is about 876 ft (about 267 m) above the New River
兩鉸桁架拱，拱矢 370 英尺，矢跨比約 1:4.6~A two-hinged truss arch with a 370 ft rise, a rise-to-span ratio of about 1:4.6
公開重量約 8,800 萬磅（約 39,900 公噸），採 COR-TEN B 耐候鋼免塗裝~The published weight is about 88 million lb (about 39,900 t), in unpainted COR-TEN B weathering steel
拱上 14 跨上承桁架每跨約 129 英尺 9 英寸，排架間距 72 英尺~Fourteen deck-truss spans over the arch are about 129 ft 9 in each, with bents at 72 ft
纜索吊運跨距約 3,500 英尺，塔架約 330 英尺，最重吊運約 92 噸~The cableway spanned about 3,500 ft from towers about 330 ft tall, with a heaviest lift of about 92 tons
1976 年以 16 具 1,250 噸液壓千斤頂下放兩側拱臂合龍~In 1976 sixteen 1,250-ton hydraulic jacks lowered both arms for closure
1974 年 6 月開工，1977 年 10 月 22 日通車，造價逾 3,700 萬美元~Construction began in June 1974 and the bridge opened on 22 October 1977, costing more than US$37 million
2013 年列入美國國家史蹟名錄~Listed on the US National Register of Historic Places in 2013

timeline.event: 6 月開工，開始建造推力座與纜索吊運系統~Construction begins in June with thrust blocks and the cableway
夏季安裝第一段拱弦桿，開始背拉懸臂架設~The first arch chord is placed in summer, starting tieback cantilevering
5 月以千斤頂下放拱臂合龍，11 月 1 日最後一段橋面桁架就位~The arch is jacked down to closure in May, and the last deck truss is set on 1 November
10 月 22 日正式通車，取代穿越峽谷的繞行道路~Opens to traffic on 22 October, replacing the long road detour through the gorge
首屆官方橋梁日活動，開放行人上橋~The first official Bridge Day opens the deck to pedestrians
